product.title: 4 Hour Shared Big Game Fishing

description.text: Head offshore from Fort Lauderdale for a shared big game fishing trip with crew support and equipment ready onboard. Target seasonal species in productive Atlantic waters and enjoy a half-day fishing adventure suitable for beginners and experienced anglers.

highlights: Join a shared offshore fishing trip from Fort Lauderdale
Fish with experienced crew support and local knowledge
Use onboard rods, reels, and tackle
Great half-day option for groups and solo travelers

start.description: Meet at the Fort Lauderdale marina prior to departure. Boarding instructions and exact location are provided after booking.

itineraryItems.title: Check-in at marina
itineraryItems.description: Arrive, check in, and board the fishing vessel.

itineraryItems.title: Cruise to offshore fishing grounds
itineraryItems.description: Travel to active fishing areas selected by the captain.

itineraryItems.title: Shared big game fishing session
itineraryItems.description: Fish with provided gear and assistance from the crew.

additionalInfo: Catch is seasonal and not guaranteed
Bring sun protection and non-slip footwear
Check in early to ensure on-time departure

faqs.question: Is this trip suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, beginners are welcome and crew assist with setup and technique.

faqs.question: How long is the fishing trip?
faqs.answer: The shared charter runs approximately 4 hours.

faqs.question: Is fishing gear included?
faqs.answer: Yes, rods, reels, and tackle are included.
